scope: Only apps/sync-server/src/bound-auth.test.ts final two expiry-after-bootstrap cases
implementation: Reuse Date-only vi.useFakeTimers pattern already used in packages/binding/src/bound-sync.test.ts. Real HTTP, RSA/EC signatures, PGlite and actual timers remain real. A try/finally always restores the real Date.
originalFailure: The near-expiry DPoP request returned 401 but bootstrap call count remained 1 rather than 2. Original CI did not record its exact entry timestamp.
raceMechanism: The proof uses floor(Date.now()/1000)-59. The strict fractional 60-second entry validation leaves more than 0 and at most 1 second before expiry; signing/HTTP/scheduling can consume it before bootstrap. Product correctly rejects an already expired proof.
boundaryProof: Real HTTP requests preserve status401, bootstrap count1 then2 and zero claimProof calls. At second entry the proof is 59.1s old; after the controlled bootstrap boundary it is 61.2s old while the access token remains valid.
